title: Engineer-Project Mapping
description: Maps engineers (by knox_id) to the projects they work on. Read by app.registry.engineers at startup. Refresh requires app restart in Phase 1. Documentation keys starting with '_' (e.g. _README, _help_*) and the '$schema' self-reference are tolerated at the top level — the loader ignores them and a strict validator should too via the patternProperties / propertyNames rules below.

^_.description: Documentation-only key; ignored by the loader.

$schema.description: Self-reference to this schema file. Annotation only; not validated.

engineers.description: Master list of engineers. Each engineer appears exactly once here.

name.description: Display name as it appears in JIRA's 'displayName' field

knox_id.description: Internal company unique identifier; matched against JIRA accountId/key/name/email

assignments.description: Which engineers are on which projects.

knox_id.description: Must match a knox_id in the engineers list above

projects.description: List of project codes (matching config.json projects[].code)
